description: Reserve a Quo ride and complete payment immediately, using the guest's already-linked card, only works if get_payment_method shows a linked card whose remaining 24-hour cap covers this fare. The fare is computed server-side from real pricing, never trusted from the caller. If the fare exceeds what is left of the guest's rolling 24-hour cap, or no card is linked, this refuses and suggests reserve_ride instead (a human-confirmed request with no charge). If the ride is created but the charge fails, the ride is NOT lost, it stays reserved and unpaid, and the response explains next steps. Requires session_token from verify_code.

additionalRiders.description: Other named riders on this same booking, for a group/split-fare trip, the verified phone above stays the sole booking owner and the only one charged. Purely for the driver's manifest and, if a phone is given, that rider's own SMS ride updates.

phone.description: Any common format is fine (e.g. "305-555-0100"); non-digits other than a leading + are stripped server-side.

dropoff.description: Destination, omit for an hourly/as-directed booking

flightNumber.description: For an airport pickup, Quo tracks the flight and the captain waits if it's delayed

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A unique string for this request (e.g. a UUID). If the call is retried with the same key, the original answer is returned instead of reserving and charging a second ride.

stops.description: Ordered intermediate stops between pickup and dropoff within this one reservation. Up to 3. Each stop adds a flat surcharge, and the trip is routed through the stops; both are included in the charged amount.

name: reserve_and_pay
title: Reserve a ride and pay for it automatically
